metadata.title: Documentation of National Adaptations of International Background Questionnaire Items Population 3 Final Year of Secondary School – 1995 Assessment User Guide for the TIMSS International Database Supplement 2

survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This supplement is documentation for the TIMSS international database, not an empirical analysis of student achievement. It describes how national adaptations of TIMSS Population 3 background questionnaire items are coded for secondary analyses, including country-level availability codes (D = included; X = not included). Because no analytic sample is modeled here, the document does not specify the use of complex survey weights or replicate-weight procedures; users should consult the accompanying TIMSS User Guide for the background questionnaire survey design and weighting variables. For secondary analyses, the key data-preparation step is to use the documented variable names and apply the D/X availability rules (and any country-specific questionnaire-version filters such as IDSTRAT) so that contextual variables are interpreted consistently across countries.

data.handling_not_reported_explanation: This document does not estimate models with cognitive outcomes or plausible values; it provides item-level documentation for national adaptations of background questionnaire variables. As a result, plausible values handling is not applicable, and missing-data handling for PV-based estimation is not described because no PV-based scoring or model estimation is performed. The only relevant “missingness” here is the D/X coding indicating whether a country’s data are included in the international variable for each background item.

sample_details.sample_filtering_criteria: No analytic student sample is constructed in this supplement. Instead, it documents which TIMSS Population 3 background questionnaire items (and subitems) are available internationally for each country using D (included) and X (not included) codes, and it notes country-specific questionnaire versions (e.g., Czech Republic G vs V; Germany multiple student/school versions) that can be identified via IDSTRAT for filtering in secondary analyses.

data.outcome_summary: This supplement is a TIMSS International Database user guide (Supplement 2) that documents national adaptations of international background questionnaire items for TIMSS Population 3 (Final Year of Secondary School) and the 1995 assessment. It does not analyze achievement outcomes or estimate statistical models; instead, it provides item-by-item documentation for student and school contextual variables, including abbreviated question text, the corresponding international variable names, and country-specific notes. For each item, countries are coded as D (national data included in the international variable with documentation of adaptations) or X (national data not included because items were not administered, not applicable, deleted, or not internationally comparable). The document also explains how to handle country-specific questionnaire versions (e.g., using IDSTRAT to distinguish versions) so that secondary analysts can construct internationally comparable contextual datasets. Benchmarks and performance metrics are therefore not applicable because no predictive or causal results are produced.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This record is a documentation supplement rather than an empirical research paper. Consequently, there is no modeled dependent variable, no ML algorithm training/evaluation, no reported sample size, and no performance metrics. The sparse fields (e.g., missing year/author metadata and null sample sizes) reflect that the document’s purpose is to guide secondary data use and variable comparability, not to conduct an analysis.
